name: Pileated Provisioner
description: Flying. When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control without flying.
notes: First attempt found a real gap: PutCounter never called qualifierFlags(ValidTgts$) at all (unlike ChangeZone/Destroy/Pump), so the .withoutFlying restriction was silently lost with owner still correct (YouCtrl) but the flying restriction entirely absent. Fixed by adding the same qualifierFlags call PutCounter's siblings already had, plus added .withFlying/.withoutFlying to qualifierFlags' vocabulary (also closes part of Jackdaw Savior's still-open gap). Verified: node E now shows cond:withoutflying alongside the delta payload. Full match. In blb-success.json.
